subject: CRM hygiene — Q2 forecast commit cleanup and probability refresh
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: CRM hygiene — Q2 forecast commit cleanup and probability refresh

Team,

Quick ask before finance finalizes the Q2 forecast: we need a one-pass cleanup across committed/opportunity records tied to RH-2345-CH and other top commits. Specifically please do the following by EOD PT tomorrow (Thu, Jun 11):

1) Confirm deal amount and product/SKU — update the "Line Items" in HubSpot so finance can map to P&L (include exact SKU strings).
2) Set the next concrete step in HubSpot (not "Follow up") — add a date and owner.
3) Refresh probability to reflect where the buyer actually is today (no autopopulate rules). If a number is disputed, note the reason in the deal notes.
4) Mark true commit stage only for deals where legal/finance procurement are aligned or we've received signed SOW/PoC purchase intent.
5) Attach or link any procurement artifacts (SOW, vendor redlines, PO/email confirmations).

I've attached a small CSV export with the current Q2 commit list to make this quick (see Q2_commit_list.csv). Use forecast_cleanup_template.xlsx if you want a local copy to work from — we'll ingest edits directly in HubSpot.

Priority: top 12 deals by amount (I flagged them in the CSV). If you need clarification on mapping SKUs or the revenue cadence, loop me in — I can hop on a quick call. The goal is to remove noise so finance doesn't have to make guesses.

Thanks — Sean
--
Sean Gallagher
Director, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

Thanks Laura — looks good. Two quick clarifications after scanning the CSV: 

- Deal RH-2345-CH: The amount listed is $420,000 in the CSV but the signed SOW shows $360,000 (annualized vs. one-time professional services got double-counted). Laura — can you confirm which line items we should keep? Finance needs the final breakdown by SKU (base subscription vs. PS).
- Probability guidance: please use conservative rounding (0%, 25%, 50%, 75%, 100%) so the model doesn't overfit small changes. If you think a mid-value is required, add a short justification in the deal notes.

I also recommend tagging any deals where procurement has requested changes to payment terms — that materially impacts cash recognition and our April vs. July sequencing.

Rishi
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Appreciate the quick turn, team. Final alignment / plan: 

1) Laura: please update RH-2345-CH to $360,000 and map SKUs as follows: RED-BASIC-ANNUAL = $300,000, RED-PS-ONE-TIME = $60,000. Put a short note referencing the signed SOW (attached to the deal).
2) Rishi: thanks for the rounding guidance — we'll adopt the 25/50/75 buckets for the forecast model. Finance has signaled they will treat anything <50% as not committed.
3) Monica: please confirm whether Procurement at Catalyst Health has provided a PO/intent. I cc'd Jordan on this thread — Jordan, can you confirm procurement timing? If you prefer, we can pull a short call (15m) today.

I've uploaded the forecast_cleanup_template.xlsx to the deal record and attached a docusign link for the pending SOW so finance can reconcile. If everyone can finish edits in HubSpot (or drop completed CSV rows back to me) by EOD PT today, I will run the commit report and hand it to finance first thing Friday morning.

Thanks — Sean
